summary: Practise evaluating dashboards, AI outputs, and data quality without coding. Explore the course and strengthen evidence-based decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make business or policy decisions using dashboards, AI insights, or analytics reports, but do not need to code or build models.
audience: Customer experience managers using feedback analytics
prerequisites: No coding or model-building experience is required. Familiarity with workplace dashboards, analytics reports, or performance metrics will help you connect the case exercises to your role.
